install.notes: The repository's README installs it with the conda environment of environment.yml (python 3.6, pyvisa 1.8.0, nidaqmx-python, pint and qcodes 0.1.11, environment.yml:5-27) and runs it with the clone's scanning-squid directory on the path (docs/pages/workflow.rst:15); 'pip install .' does not work because setup.py names a scanning_squid package directory the checkout does not have (setup.py:7). The hardware backend also needs the NI-DAQ, GPIB and serial hardware of the microscope. The gate never installs or imports any of it.
